title: product_candidate_availability_vocabulary@0.1.0
comment: ADR-052 (G6-V). The candidate-admission vocabulary for the product_extraction stage. availability_status is an unconstrained string in product_observation.schema.json, so which statuses may enter a candidate record is governed here instead. This is not the Rule-10 evaluator classification of ADR-028: that one decides whether a capability or task record is supported only by future-roadmap evidence at the evaluation stages, this one decides candidate admission at extraction. Neither is derived from the other and they are not required to carry the same tokens. admitted_status_values is the exact canonical taxonomy of docs/methodology/PRODUCT_CAPABILITY_TASK_ONTOLOGY.md -- eight tokens, ascending, closed enum, minItems equal to maxItems -- so adding or removing a status under 0.1.0 is impossible and requires a contract successor; planned, which the ontology does not define, cannot appear in any list. The four partition lists cover admitted_status_values completely and pairwise disjointly, which the loader enforces because JSON Schema cannot; unknown_status_values is fixed at exactly ["unknown"] because insufficient evidence is a result that is carried, never reclassified as inactive. availability_taxonomy_reference and availability_taxonomy_sha256 bind the artifact to the literal bytes of the taxonomy text it was minted against, so the ontology cannot change underneath a live vocabulary; the pin proves which text, not that the eight tokens were mechanically extracted from it, and no code parses the ontology at runtime. decided_by and decided_at record the human who made the one judgement this artifact contains -- what each admitted token means for candidate admission -- and decided_at must carry an explicit UTC offset.
